forwarded-for: X-Forwarded-For
  # One entry per contract FileType, or the app does not start. A disabled type gets 403, and a
  # Content-Length above max-size gets 413.
  file-types:
    app-log:
      enabled: true
      max-size: 10MB
    boot-log:
      enabled: true
      max-size: 10MB
    # Personal data. Stays off until the privacy review says yes (ADR 0008).
    calls-xml:
      enabled: false
      max-size: 10MB
  storage:
    # Below the ALB idle timeout of 120 s, so the phone hears 429 from the service instead of a
    # timeout from the ALB. Change it together with the ALB and Tomcat values (ADR 0005).
    write-timeout: 60s

content.text:
**Why it's rejected:** calls.xml holds personal data and makes up 65% of uploads, so ADR 0008 keeps it disabled in config until a privacy review approves it. In `application.yml` it is set to `device-logs.file-types.calls-xml.enabled: false`. The ADR also says it must never be enabled by default; turning it on is a config change after the review.

**What status it gets:** **403 Forbidden.** `UploadPolicy` checks the headers and rejects the upload with `Rejection.FILE_TYPE_DISABLED`. `RejectionStatusMapper` maps that rejection to `HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN`. This happens even when the headers are valid and before the body is read. `LogUploadControllerTest` asserts `PUT /logs/0004f2abcdef-calls.xml` → 403.

Also, `FileType.CALLS_XML` has `manualAllowed = false`, so a `<mac>-now-calls.xml` name isn't a valid file name at all.

- `docs/architecture/decisions/0008-reject-calls-xml.md`
- `upload-service/src/main/resources/application.yml`
- `upload-service/src/main/java/com/_8x8/herd/device_logs/upload/policy/UploadPolicy.java`
- `upload-service/src/main/java/com/_8x8/herd/device_logs/upload/policy/Rejection.java`
- `upload-service/src/main/java/com/_8x8/herd/device_logs/upload/web/RejectionStatusMapper.java`
- `upload-service/openapi.yaml`
- `upload-service/src/test/java/com/_8x8/herd/device_logs/upload/web/LogUploadControllerTest.java`
- `contract/src/main/java/com/_8x8/herd/device_logs/contract/FileType.java`
- `contract/src/test/java/com/_8x8/herd/device_logs/contract/LogFileNameTest.java`
